svg.text: HOT CUE button. Two pages of 8 hot cues.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • A hot cue lights in its Mixxx colour (nearest of the pad's 61 colours). Bright.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • A saved loop is always ORANGE, and blinks while it runs. Orange means loop, nothing else.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • New hot cues get a random colour (never orange, never the same twice in a row). Empty pads are off.
